subject: H3 must use model id 'minimax-h3' or the licence gate silently does not fire
body: MPI-451 has landed: a licence-acceptance gate now sits in downloadService.start(), in front of the install of any model that carries a descriptor in js/data/modelConstants/licences.js. The descriptor is keyed by MODEL ID, and the H3 entry is keyed 'minimax-h3'. I keyed it off the model id rather than putting a field on the ModelDef precisely so that we would not both be editing models.js at the same time. One consequence you need to know about: if your ModelDef ends up with a different id -- 'minimax_h3', 'h3', 'minimax-h3-t2v', anything -- the lookup misses and H3 installs with NO consent gate at all. It does not error and it does not warn; it just quietly behaves like an ungated model, which is the exact outcome the flow-down commitment in our authorization forbids. So either name the ModelDef 'minimax-h3', or reply here with the id you picked and I will re-key the descriptor. If H3 ships as more than one card later (the reference-to-video variant), every one of those ids needs its own key in MODEL_LICENCES pointing at the same descriptor object -- again data only, no code. Two things from MPI-451's brief that I deliberately left for MPI-452, because they are in your acceptance criteria and not mine: the NOTICE file with the licensor's exact required string, and the 'Powered by MiniMax H3' attribution on the product surface. The gate LINKS the full licence (HF blob URL) rather than bundling the text, so 'the licence text ships and is reachable in-app' is still open on your side. Contract if you want to test the gate: getModelLicence(id) returns the descriptor or null, hasAcceptedLicence(id) is the check, and the receipt lives in localStorage under mpi_model_licence_accepted -- clear that key to make the dialog show again.

events.note: Replied c4a91f7e-2d38-4b6a-9e15-7f2c8d4b3a60: id confirmed as 'minimax-h3', no re-key needed.
